# [RowExpansionConfig()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-function}

::: {.doc-subject}

:::

::: {.doc-usage-source}
Usage

[Source](https://github.com/jeffgallini/dash-mantine-datatable/blob/main/dash_mantine_datatable\__init__.py#L558-L597){target="_blank" rel="noopener"}
:::

::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION}
```python
RowExpansionConfig(content=None, /, **kwargs)
```
:::

## Description {.doc-description}

Build a row-expansion configuration dictionary for detail panels shown
beneath a record.

## Parameters {.doc-parameters}

::: {.doc-definition-items}
<code>[content]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [Any]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default}</code>

:   Description: Dash component or payload rendered when a row is expanded.
    Example: `content=dmc.Text("Employee details")`.

<code>[allowMultiple]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [bool]{.doc-parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Description: Allows multiple rows to stay expanded at the same time.
    Example: `allowMultiple=True`.

<code>[trigger]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str]{.doc-parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Description: Chooses how expansion is toggled.
    Expected inputs: frontend-supported trigger values such as `'click'`
    when available.
    Example: `trigger="click"`.
:::

## Returns {.doc-returns}

::: {.doc-definition-items}
<code> [dict]{.doc-parameter-annotation}</code>

:   A dictionary with `None` values removed.
:::

## Notes {.doc-notes}

This helper is especially useful when you want to keep expansion config in
one place and reuse it across multiple table instances.

## Examples {.doc-examples}

```python
>>> RowExpansionConfig(content="More details", allowMultiple=True)
{'allowMultiple': True, 'content': 'More details'}
```
